name: Ayoub
source:
Ayoub attends a new school and meets new friends. Ayoub is selected to play a game that aims to develop robot capabilities. While Ayoub struggles to keep the game secret, mysterious cards appear in the school related to this game.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1439420/]Steam[/url]]
